key_insight: SQuAT improves low-bit LLM vector quantization-aware training by separating direction and magnitude gradients, implicitly enabling spherical optimization.
engineering_relevance: Distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment cuts VQ-QAT training time by 12.8×, making training at a 10B-token scale feasible.
method: Split weight vectors into normalized directions and gains.
Quantize directions with an E8-derived spherical codebook and gains with low-bit scalar quantizers.
Use separate straight-through estimators; distribute weight-block assignments and communicate only discrete indices.
evidence_signal: Across LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B, Qwen3-4B, and base Qwen3-1.7B, SQuAT consistently outperforms standard VQ-QAT STE with identical quantizers and initialization, reporting state-of-the-art VQ-QAT accuracy.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify hardware or evaluation metrics, limiting assessment of the reported speedup and accuracy gains.
paper_title: SQuAT: Spherical Lattice Vector Quantization-Aware Training
